questions.question: What is meant by “direct sampling” in software defined radios?

choices.A: Software is converted from source code to object code during operation of the receiver
choices.B: I and Q signals are generated by digital processing without the use of RF amplification
choices.C: Incoming RF is digitized by an analog-to-digital converter without being mixed with a local oscillator signal
choices.D: A switching mixer is used to generate I and Q signals directly from the RF input

questions.answer: Incoming RF is digitized by an analog-to-digital converter without being mixed with a local oscillator signal

questions.question: What kind of digital signal processing audio filter is used to remove unwanted noise from a received SSB signal?

choices.A: An adaptive filter
choices.B: A crystal-lattice filter

questions.answer: An adaptive filter

questions.question: What type of digital signal processing filter is used to generate an SSB signal?

choices.A: An adaptive filter
choices.B: A notch filter

questions.answer: A Hilbert-transform filter

questions.question: Which method generates an SSB signal using digital signal processing?

choices.A: Mixing products are converted to voltages and subtracted by adder circuits
choices.B: A frequency synthesizer removes unwanted sidebands
choices.C: Varying quartz crystal characteristics are emulated in digital form
choices.D: Signals are combined in quadrature phase relationship

questions.answer: Signals are combined in quadrature phase relationship

questions.question: How frequently must an analog signal be sampled to be accurately reproduced?

choices.A: At least half the rate of the highest frequency component of the signal
choices.B: At least twice the rate of the highest frequency component of the signal
choices.C: At the same rate as the highest frequency component of the signal
choices.D: At four times the rate of the highest frequency component of the signal

questions.answer: At least twice the rate of the highest frequency component of the signal

questions.question: What is the minimum number of bits required to sample a signal with a range of 1 volt at a resolution of 1 millivolt?

choices.A: 4 bits
choices.B: 6 bits

questions.answer: 10 bits

questions.question: What function is performed by a Fast Fourier Transform?

choices.A: Converting analog signals to digital form
choices.B: Converting digital signals to analog form
choices.C: Converting signals from the time domain to the frequency domain
choices.D: Converting signals from the frequency domain to the time domain

questions.answer: Converting signals from the time domain to the frequency domain

questions.question: What is the function of decimation?

choices.A: Converting data to binary-coded decimal form
choices.B: Reducing the effective sample rate by removing samples

questions.answer: Reducing the effective sample rate by removing samples

questions.question: Why is an anti-aliasing filter required in a decimator?

choices.A: It removes high-frequency signal components that would otherwise be reproduced as lower frequency components
choices.B: It peaks the response of the decimator, improving bandwidth
choices.C: It removes low-frequency signal components to eliminate the need for DC restoration
choices.D: It notches out the sampling frequency to avoid sampling errors

questions.answer: It removes high-frequency signal components that would otherwise be reproduced as lower frequency components

questions.question: What aspect of receiver analog-to-digital conversion determines the maximum receive bandwidth of a direct-sampling software defined radio (SDR)?

choices.A: Sample rate
choices.B: Sample width in bits

questions.answer: Sample rate

questions.question: What sets the minimum detectable signal level for a direct-sampling software defined receiver in the absence of atmospheric or thermal noise?

choices.A: Sample clock phase noise
choices.B: Reference voltage level and sample width in bits

questions.answer: Reference voltage level and sample width in bits

questions.question: Which of the following is generally true of Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filters?

choices.A: FIR filters can delay all frequency components of the signal by the same amount
choices.B: FIR filters are easier to implement for a given set of passband rolloff requirements
choices.C: FIR filters can respond faster to impulses

questions.answer: FIR filters can delay all frequency components of the signal by the same amount

questions.question: What is the function of taps in a digital signal processing filter?

choices.A: To reduce excess signal pressure levels
choices.B: Provide access for debugging software
choices.C: Select the point at which baseband signals are generated
choices.D: Provide incremental signal delays for filter algorithms

questions.answer: Provide incremental signal delays for filter algorithms

questions.question: Which of the following would allow a digital signal processing filter to create a sharper filter response?

choices.A: Higher data rate
choices.B: More taps

questions.answer: More taps

questions.question: What technique shows that a square wave is made up of a sine wave and its odd harmonics?

choices.A: Fourier analysis
choices.B: Vector analysis

questions.answer: Fourier analysis

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of analog-to-digital conversion?

choices.A: Successive approximation
choices.B: Harmonic regeneration

questions.answer: Successive approximation

questions.question: Which of the following describes a signal in the time domain?

choices.A: Power at intervals of phase
choices.B: Amplitude at different times

questions.answer: Amplitude at different times

questions.question: What is “dither” with respect to analog-to-digital converters?

choices.A: An abnormal condition where the converter cannot settle on a value to represent the signal
choices.B: A small amount of noise added to the input signal to reduce quantization noise
choices.C: An error caused by irregular quantization step size
choices.D: A method of decimation by randomly skipping samples

questions.answer: A small amount of noise added to the input signal to reduce quantization noise

questions.question: What is the benefit of making voltage measurements with a true-RMS calculating meter?

choices.A: An inverse Fourier transform can be used
choices.B: The signal’s RMS noise factor is also calculated
choices.C: The calculated RMS value can be converted directly into phasor form
choices.D: RMS is measured for both sinusoidal and non-sinusoidal signals

questions.answer: RMS is measured for both sinusoidal and non-sinusoidal signals

questions.question: What is the approximate ratio of PEP-to-average power in an unprocessed single-sideband phone signal?

choices.B: 25 to 1

questions.question: What determines the PEP-to-average power ratio of an unprocessed single-sideband phone signal?

choices.A: The frequency of the modulating signal
choices.B: Speech characteristics

questions.answer: Speech characteristics

questions.question: Why are direct or flash conversion analog-to-digital converters used for a software defined radio?

choices.A: Very low power consumption decreases frequency drift
choices.B: Immunity to out-of-sequence coding reduces spurious responses
choices.C: Very high speed allows digitizing high frequencies

questions.answer: Very high speed allows digitizing high frequencies

questions.question: How many different input levels can be encoded by an analog-to-digital converter with 8-bit resolution?

choices.B: 8 multiplied by the gain of the input amplifier
choices.C: 256 divided by the gain of the input amplifier

questions.question: What is the purpose of a low-pass filter used at the output of a digital-to-analog converter?

choices.A: Lower the input bandwidth to increase the effective resolution
choices.B: Improve accuracy by removing out-of-sequence codes from the input
choices.C: Remove spurious sampling artifacts from the output signal

questions.answer: Remove spurious sampling artifacts from the output signal

questions.question: Which of the following is a measure of the quality of an analog-to-digital converter?

choices.A: Total harmonic distortion
choices.B: Peak envelope power

questions.answer: Total harmonic distortion
